scenario: A Claude-implemented pull request (`agent/issue-245-*`) is still open while its issue is blocked. A human removes `agent-blocked` and applies `agent-ready-copilot` without closing it, so the issue is claimed again for the Copilot route. A pending review, a manual re-review request and the next head update of the old pull request all reach the pipeline afterwards. Separately, an agent posts a comment as `github-actions[bot]` that claims a different route.
expectedBehavior: The newest claim in the issue's label history no longer matches the pull request, which was also opened before that claim, so every boundary fails closed: no verdict is published for the old review, and no validation, review or repair runs on that pull request. A human resolves it, for example by closing the old pull request. The pipeline never re-routes the pull request to the other provider or reuses the old verdict, and it ignores comments entirely when deciding the route.
forbiddenOutcomes: Publishing the review verdict after the claimed mode changed.
Silently switching the pull request to the other provider's review or repair route.
Treating a missing or conflicting claim, or a comment that names a route, as evidence for any route.

assertions.text: The provider is never switched automatically; a human must resolve it.
